proof.text: For a point x of X, Mathlib irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x supplies an irreducible component. The cover hypothesis supplies i : Fin 0 for that component, contradicting Fin.elim0. Thus the underlying type of X is empty.

Choose the bottom open U. Density is vacuous because X has no points. The open subscheme U is empty; Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_of_isEmpty makes every scheme morphism into it an isomorphism, in particular the restriction of the coproduct morphism. No componentwise gluing is needed.

title: Empty-family dense-open gluing
statement: For the empty finite family satisfying the component-cover hypotheses, the coproduct modification is an isomorphism over a dense open.

theorem exists_dense_open_isIso_component_modifications_of_zero
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced X]
    (C : Fin 0 → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ i, C i ⟶ X)
    (hC : ∀ i, IsIntegral (C i) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (ι i) ∧
      Set.range (ι i) ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => Set.range (ι i)))
    (hcover : ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X, ∃ i, Set.range (ι i) = Z)
    (Y : Fin 0 → Scheme.{u}) (ν : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ C i)
    (hν : ∀ i, ∃ U : (C i).Opens, Dense (U : Set (C i)) ∧ IsIso (ν i ∣_ U)) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, Dense (U : Set X) ∧
      IsIso (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc (fun i => ν i ≫ ι i) ∣_ U)
